name: crunch
description: The crunch skill's nudge where the developer sees it: the context's size under the prompt, a toast and a log line at each nudge, and a band that compacts on a focus the session drafts.

showStatusLine.title: Status line
showStatusLine.description: The context's size under the prompt, with a hint once the hook has nudged

showToast.title: Toast
showToast.description: A toast at each nudge, where something other than a terminal draws the session

showLog.title: Log line
showLog.description: A line in the transcript at each nudge, where something other than a terminal draws the session

showBand.title: Band
showBand.description: Above the prompt from each nudge until dismissed or used: what fills the context, and Compact now beside the focus the session drafts for /compact

showNotification.title: Notification
showNotification.description: A native notification at each nudge, through the terminal's notification channel

addNote.title: Note after compacting
addNote.description: After each compaction, a note Claude reads, telling it to read the project's PROGRESS.md first, where there is one
